description: This Java class configures the Spring Boot setup for the Hono COAP adapter, defining beans, customizing client factory configurations, and exposing configuration properties specific to the COAP adapter.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for the Hono COAP adapter, extending AbstractAdapterConfig and defining beans and configuration methods.

methods.name: vertxBasedCoapAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of VertxBasedCoapAdapter with prototype scope.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides parent method to set default name for downstream sender factory if not set.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides parent method to set default name for registration client factory if not set.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides parent method to set default name for credentials client factory if not set.

methods.name: customizeTenantClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides parent method to set default name for tenant client factory if not set.

methods.name: adapterProperties
methods.description: Defines a bean exposing COAP adapter configuration properties with prefix 'hono.coap'.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Creates a MeterRegistryCustomizer that adds common tags for the protocol adapter type COAP.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory bean for producing instances of the COAP adapter.
